{{Quote|No longer will Gungans pound and slave for other Gungs. Weesa will rebuild this place as a city of peace, not war.|Boss Gallo|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
'''Gallo''' was an [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who lived around [[3000 BBY]]. Gallo was the [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Sancture]] until it was [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|destroyed]] in a [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes while he was out [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] for the annual [[Sacred Feast]]. After meeting rogue [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]] and trading his captured nerfs for [[glurrg]] workers, Gallo ran into a [[Unidentified militiagung (Otoh Sancture)|militiagung]], or Gungan warrior, who informed him that Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the Gungan [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] who had masterminded the war, was behind the destruction of Otoh Sancture.

Determined to seek justice for the act, Gallo set out to unite the surrounding Gungan tribes against Rogoe and his [[Rogoe's army|militia]]. After Gallo rebuilt the town of Otoh Sancture, he and Marsune, who had decided to join Gallo on his journey, traveled to the cities of [[Otoh Jahai]], [[Otoh Langua/Legends|Otoh Langua]], [[Otoh Urs]], and [[Otoh Raban]] to speak with Bosses [[Tenko]], [[Hantic]], [[Copek (Gungan)|Copek]], and [[Hoxie]], respectively. After Gallo fulfilled tasks provided by each Boss, the four agreed to join Gallo's cause. Gallo took his forces and, along with [[Bongo Laser|bongo]] [[Submarine/Legends|submarines]] acquired from the Gungan manufacturer [[Bongomeken Collective]], [[Raid on Spearhead|attacked]] Rogoe's city of [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]]. Once the city and [[Rogoe's keep]] were destroyed. Gallo founded a new city in its place called [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. He was a distant ancestor of Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], who lived during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Each Gungan tribe was always punden da other, but Gallo refused to raisen his arms against hisen fellow Gungans.|Rugor Nass|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Gallo was an [[Ankura/Legends|Ankura]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived<ref name="SW:GB" /> around [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="EA" /> He became the [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] of the Gungan [[City/Legends|settlement]] [[Otoh Sancture]] sometime prior to the [[War of the Gungan tribes|war]] between the Gungan tribes in 3000 BBY. During the war, Gallo refused to join in the fighting, leading some Gungans to wonder who he would join if he decided to fight. Most concerned was Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe]], the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] responsible for the war, due to Boss Gallo's immense wealth.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Destruction of Otoh Sancture===
{{Quote|No! Mesa People are bein destroyen!|Boss Gallo|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
{{Main|Destruction of Otoh Sancture}}
[[File:MarsunesBase-SWGB.png|thumb|right|350px|Gallo meets with Marsune.]]
As was tradition for Bosses in Gungan culture, Gallo went out to collect some animals for Otoh Sancture's [[Sacred Feast]], using a kaadu, a local bipedal beast, for transportation. While Gallo was [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] for [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]], Otoh Sancture was [[Destruction of Otoh Sancture|attacked]] by a [[Bursa clan (Otoh Sancture)|clan]] of [[Bursa/Legends|bursas]], quadrupedal [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] beasts . Gallo returned to find the settlement in ruins and his subjects [[Death/Legends|dead]]. He then proceeded north, just past a river, where he met [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marsune (Gungan)|Marsune]] in a [[Marsune's base|small base]]. Gallo traded the nerfs he captured to Marsune for four non-sentient [[glurrg]] workers. Gallo set off with the workers to find a suitable area to rebuild Otoh Sancture.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Along the way, Gallo crossed paths with a [[Unidentified militiagung (Otoh Sancture)|militiagung]], or Gungan warrior, who informed him that the bursas responsible for destroying his village were sent by Boss Rogoe. Gallo swore to avenge his people and set out to rebuild his settlement in an area abundant in [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], [[Ore/Legends|ore]], food, and [[Tree/Legends|trees]], which could be used as a source of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], as all four of these were necessary resources. After rebuilding Otoh Sancture and raising a small militia, he [[Battle of Otoh Sancture|eliminated]] the bursas that had decimated the village, as they had created nests in the rubble. After Gallo finished slaughtering the bursas, Marsune appeared, claiming that he would like to see Rogoe fall, and thus he joined Gallo on his journey.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Uniting the tribes===
{{Quote|Boss Gallo sleepen well that night because hesa bringen all the Gungan tribes together.|Boss Nass|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Otoh_Jatai.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Gallo arrives in Otoh Jahai.]]
Gallo then set out to unite the Gungan tribes to fight against Rogoe. He first visited the city of [[Otoh Jahai]] and consulted Boss [[Tenko]], who told Gallo that the city of [[Otoh Langua/Legends|Otoh Langua]] had stolen their [[Sacred Staff]]. Tenko made Gallo a deal, stating that if Gallo returned the [[Staff/Legends|staff]], he would contribute some men to Gallo. Upon Gallo's arrival in Otoh Langua, Boss [[Hantic]] claimed they did not have the staff but instead promised that if Gallo gave him a thousand nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] he would join the fight. Marsune told Gallo that he had heard rumors of a hidden [[Rogoe's spaceport|spaceport]] that might have the nova they needed. After leaving Otoh Langua, they found two paths: one was guarded by [[Rogoe's army]], and the other was a clear path. Gallo and his few men defeated Rogoe's forces and found the Sacred Staff of Otoh Jahai. They then headed back down the road in search of the rumored [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Off to the side of the road they found a small path leading into the woods, which they followed, leading to the discovery of the rumored spaceport guarded by Rogoe's men. They eliminated the opposition and destroyed the spaceport, getting a thousand nova crystals in return.<ref name="SW:GB" />

After returning to Otoh Langua and handing the nova to boss Hantic, Gallo received four [[Kaadu/Legends|Kaadu Cavalry]]. Next he headed to Otoh Jahai and returned the staff to Boss Tenko, who gave him four heavy [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. Gallo then embarked for [[Otoh Urs]]. Once Gallo arrived, Boss [[Copek (Gungan)|Copek]] told them to eliminate the nearby bursa clan to convince him to join. After Gallo and his forces destroyed the bursas, Copek gave Gallo four [[Catapult/Legends|catapults]]. Gallo immediately took his men to [[Otoh Raban]], but they arrived to discover Boss [[Hoxie]] had been [[Kidnapping of Hoxie|kidnapped]]. The workers there told Gallo that if he rescued the Boss, they would join his cause. Gallo and his [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] set out to find [[Rogoe's stronghold]], where Hoxie was being held. Upon their arrival, a [[Battle of the Forest Cities|battle]] broke out, and the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] inside the facilities rioted, giving Gallo more [[Troop/Legends|troops]]. Gallo was thus successful in rescuing Hoxie, and his efforts were compensated for with four repeater troopers.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Defeating Rogoe===
{{Quote|Noah one in all the history of the Gungans had conqueren Spearhead. But Gallo's army was strong, and hisen desire to defeat Rogoe was even stronger.|Boss Nass|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
{{Main|Raid on Spearhead}}
[[File:Grand_Army_to_Spearhead.png|thumb|right|300px|The Grand Army marches on Spearhead.]]
With the newly formed [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]], Gallo went to the city of [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]] to kill Rogoe<ref name="SW:GB" /> and defeat the remaining holdouts against the Gungan unification.<ref name="Nex">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
Along the way, Gallo came across a [[Bursa clan (Spearhead)|bursa clan]] with an injured [[Bursa leader|leader]]. After healing the bursa leader, Gallo received some bursas to attack Spearhead.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

Because [[Rogoe's keep]] was [[Water/Legends|underwater]] and surrounded by Spearhead, Marsune went to the [[Bongomeken Collective base|base]] of the Gungan manufacturing company [[Bongomeken Collective]] to get [[Submarine/Legends|submarines]] called [[Bongo Laser|bongos]] for use in attacking the keep. Upon the construction of Gallo's [[Navy/Legends|navy]], the battle commenced. The united tribes sustained heavy casualties, but in the end they succeeded in killing Rogoe and destroying Spearhead. After the [[Raid on Spearhead|battle]] died down, Gallo founded the city of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]] in the ruins of Spearhead.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Hesa built the city of Otoh Gunga, and long it remained a symbol of peace between all Gungans.|Boss Nass|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The story of Gallo uniting the Gungan tribes was retold by his distant descendant Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], who hoped to embody Gallo's leadership and courage, sometime during the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="POGG">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The city of Otoh Gunga became the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the now-united Gungan civilization and a major center for [[Merchant/Legends|commerce]] and other Gungan-related issues. A game titled [[Marsune and Gallo]] retold the story of the two Gungans uniting the tribes and was played by many Gungan children.<ref name="SW:GB" /> He was remembered as a hero by generations of Gungans.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|317|Gallo, Boss}}</ref> The initial foundations of Otoh Gunga laid by Gallo came to be known as the [[Ancient Quarter/Legends|Ancient Quarter]], where Gungan machinery, buildings and other objects of historical significance were preserved.<ref name="Nex" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yousa go tell yousa boss that Gallo is coming for him-sa!|Boss Gallo swears to avenge his people|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Gallo was a determined and dedicated leader of his village. He mourned greatly at the loss of his people and vowed to avenge them at whatever cost. He was a capable military leader, as he managed to defeat Rogoe. He was a talented [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]], having convinced all the tribes to put aside their differences and come together under one common goal. He believed strongly against Gungans fighting each other, even going as far as to claim it immoral according to the [[Deity/Legends|gods]]. Thus he strove to refrain from Gungan warfare whenever possible. Gallo was a wealthy and powerful Boss, due mostly to his city of Otoh Sancture being a hub of trade, commerce, gossip, and [[Spy/Legends|spying]]. Gallo's power and prestige made him an object of fear for the tyrannical Boss Rogoe, who worried whether or not Gallo would eventually join his enemies. Gallo was an Ankura Gungan with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, a large stature, and long [[Ear/Legends|ears]].

==Equipment==
Gallo often rode around on a [[Kaadu/Legends|kaadu]] and carried a staff that he could use as a weapon. He wore brown robes with yellow trimmings around his [[Limb/Legends|feet]]. At some point, he wore chest and shoulder pads along with a necklace.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Instead of freeing themselves from the yoke of Naboo tyranny, the first half of the campaign would be about how the Gungans united under Boss Gallo to rid themselves of a vile warlord named Rogoe. Unlike the somewhat faceless Naboo, Rogoe gave me the opportunity to put a face on Gallo's enemy, and the scenarios benefited from the hero's more personal involvement in the storyline. So what looked like a crushing blow actually ended up making the scenarios better.|''Galactic Battlegrounds'' level designer Stephen J. MacManus|<ref name="Designer diary">{{LucasArts|url=products/battlegrounds/diaries3.htm|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds - Designer Diary #3}}</ref>}}
Gallo was created for the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> Prior to the game's release, Gallo was mentioned in an online chat session with game director [[Garry M. Gaber]] in response to a question about the timeline of the game's storyline, the transcript of that chat was posted to the LucasArts website on [[June 28]], 2001.<ref name="Chat">{{LucasArts|url=products/battlegrounds/chats1.htm|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds - June 28, 2001 Chat Transcript}}</ref> Players control Gallo in the first three missions of the Gungan campaigns, and it is required that Gallo survive each mission for the player to move on. Level designer [[Stephen J. McManus]] originally designed the campaigns to have Gallo fight against oppression from the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], but he was informed that according to existing continuity the two species had not [[Human-Gungan conflicts/Legends|fought]] against each other. After discussions with Gaber and fellow designer [[Reed Knight]], McManus developed the idea of a war between the Gungans, a change that he felt improved the campaign due to the more personal involvement of its protagonist.<ref name="Designer diary" />

During the briefings before each mission in ''Galactic Battlegrounds'', Gallo is depicted using gray-toned still shots<ref name="SW:GB" /> of Rugor Nass from the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> Boss Gallo shares his name with the [[Gallo (creature)|gallo fish]], and many Gungan families were named after the [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> There was also a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range called the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] on Naboo.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

The objectives in each of Gallo's missions do not have a strictly enforced timeline and can be completed in any order which the player chooses. This article is written according to the order of towns Gallo passes through as he travels from one end of the road to the other, completing the objective given in each town directly after it is given. The alliance with the bursas in the third level of the campaign, "Raid on Spearhead," is optional for the player.<ref name="SW:GB" />
